description: Measures how often a cheaper model (Sage 2) agrees with your current LLM on your samples, the confidence threshold for routing, and the monthly cost now vs a hybrid. Returns the full report as JSON.

current.description: Your current model: {"model": "<id from GET /api/models>", "effort": "<level>"} or custom prices {"in": USD per 1M input tokens, "out": USD per 1M output tokens}.

mode.description: yesno: a yes/no decision per text. extract: fields pulled out of each text.

question.description: yesno only. The yes/no question your current model answers, e.g. "Is this ticket about billing?"

samples.description: Real inputs with the answer your CURRENT model gave. Array of objects or a JSONL/CSV string. yesno: {"text","label":"yes|no"}; extract: {"text","expected":{...}}. Each text ≤ 4000 chars. Min 5. Max 10 anonymous, 25 free on the website, 500 yesno / 200 extract with a pass.

target.description: Agreement you need on the calls the cheap model keeps.

reasoningTokens.description: Measured reasoning tokens per call, if you know them; otherwise estimated from effort.

name: run_cutover_audit
title: Run an LLM cutover audit
